春天的河流很安静。The river is calm in spring.

At the library, a small team studies how a local language model processes a paragraph. They keep the original input, count each token, and compare the intermediate results before drawing conclusions. Every experiment uses the same settings and a fresh output directory.
下午，大家检查记录中的数字，讨论哪些差异来自计算方式，哪些来自数据。遇到不确定的地方，就回到原始材料核对，不把猜测写成事实。
The final note describes the method, the observed results, and the remaining questions. A second run should reproduce the first run exactly. This makes the record useful for the next person who investigates the model.
